redfin.remarks: Tucked away behind its welcoming façade, 12520 Stagg Street is more than a home—it’s a personal retreat where everyday living feels like a getaway. Designed to blur the lines between indoors and out, the spacious living and dining rooms gracefully wrap around a stunning backyard sanctuary , drawing your eye to the covered patio and tranquil spa . Whether you’re enjoying a quiet morning coffee, hosting unforgettable dinner parties, or unwinding beneath the stars, this inviting outdoor oasis becomes the heart of the home. Thoughtfully maintained and move-in ready, the property pairs timeless comfort with modern efficiency. Paid-off solar offers long-term savings and sustainability, while the attached garage features an EV charger and generous additional storage for today’s lifestyle. Upstairs, a remarkable private suite with a vaulted ceiling, large panoramic picture window, its own mini split heating and AC, opens the door to endless possibilities. With both interior and exterior stair access, this expansive level can function as a luxurious primary retreat, an ideal space for multigenerational living, a guest suite, home office, or creative studio. A bonus bedroom —perfect for a reading nook, play space, or additional storage—add even more flexibility to this exceptional floor plan. Every space has been thoughtfully designed to balance comfort, privacy, and connection, creating a home that adapts beautifully to the way you live. Whether you’re seeking peaceful evenings in your backyard spa, effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining, or the versatility to accommodate changing needs, 12520 Stagg Street offers a rare combination of warmth, sophistication, and opportunity. This is the kind of home that invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and imagine your next chapter unfolding in a place that truly feels like an escape—while remaining moments from everything North Hollywood has to offer.
